periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 35 degrees downward toward the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the primary longitudinal axis approximately 1.6 times the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering of the patch boundary, extending significantly below the eye center toward the mandibular region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide, covering approximately 45% of the visible lateral height of the shoulder area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Non-uniform curvature with a localized flattening at the superior-most apex of the visible pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Heavy yellowish-brown discoloration/staining present on the white fur of the ventral neck and upper chest area.
